params.q: Which coaching institute did Ananya Sharma, UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 13, study at?

response.reconstructed_markdown:
Ananya Sharma, who secured All India Rank \(AIR\) 13 in the UPSC CSE 2025, studied and took guidance from a couple of prominent institutes for different components of her preparation: [0] [1]

- [LevelUp IAS](https://www.levelupias.com/sociology-strategy-sessions/): She was a regular student at LevelUp IAS, where she enrolled in the Sociology Optional Foundation & Crash Course \(studying sociology under Nishad Sir\) as well as the GS Mains Master Program. She also took guidance from Santosh Sir for her interview process and later participated in mentorship and strategy sessions with them. [0] [2] [3]
- [Vision IAS](https://visionias.in/): She was associated with Vision IAS for their Abhyaas Prelims mock tests and their Personality Development / Interview Guidance Program. [1]

Would you like to know more about her sociology preparation strategy or her booklist and notes\-making process?
